name: juliet
description: Claude Code tooling for Juliet (avegancafe/Juliet), the scripted macOS + Fedora setup: the noelle agent ("I'm changing my computer config"), the skills it preloads — juliet-config, juliet-extension, juliet-cross-platform, juliet-bootstrap-step, add-app-config and add-fish-alias — and bamboo, a mod that paints Claude Code in Juliet's Bamboo theme. Shared baseline for anyone running Juliet; personal tooling lives in other plugins.

bambooLook.title: Paint the desktop and mobile apps in Bamboo
bambooLook.description: Sets the Bamboo look when a session starts. Turning it off applies from the next session. The terminal is not affected: there, pick Bamboo in /theme.
